name: Master Mounter
description: Improves mounting and mounted wound creation.

name: Fortify
description: Raises attack and defense after fainting, up to two times.

name: Hunter Gatherer
description: Speeds up gathering and helps prevent gathering or carving knockback.

name: Honey Hunter
description: Increases honey obtained from gathering points.

name: Inspiration
description: Temporarily boosts attack when companion-affecting effects apply nearby.

name: Wylk Burst
description: Improves stamina and red-gauge recovery near Wylkrystals.

name: Fleetfoot
description: Improves crouch movement and monster detection escape.

name: Adrenaline
description: Temporarily reduces stamina use at low health.

name: Diversion
description: Draws more monster attention while attacking.

name: Resuscitate
description: Raises attack while affected by ailments.

name: Ward of Wyveria
description: Reduces elemental and unique damage in the Ruins of Wyveria.

name: Forager's Luck
description: Improves chances to find rare gathering points.

name: Carving Master
description: Grants one additional carve from carcasses during quests.

name: Guts (Tenacity)
description: Boosts attack, lowers defense, and can prevent one lethal hit before shifting to defense and resistance.

name: Satsui no Hado
description: Improves special actions and offset-related Drive Impact effects.
